about: Let us take you to Utopia, a world of pure fun where you ride powerful watercraft on waves so state-of-the-art you need to feel them to believe them. Aqua Moto Racing Utopia transports you to dreamlike exotic worlds where you experience speed and nerve-wracking tension in places like the Amazon, the Tropics, Greece and a mangrove swamp. Landing that perfect stunt in a narrow mangrove-lined waterway will surely put a smile on your face!

Start a single-player career as a championship driver and use your growing skill and earnings to advance until you finally become world champion. Play online and build a reputation or sit next to your friends with split-screen local action and laugh at their mistakes. But whatever happens, remember: what goes around just might come around in the next race.
Get Ready For The Wave Ride Of Your Life!
Network Players 2-8 - Full game requires PlayStation®Plus membership to access online multiplayer
